# Getting help

Start with [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md) for the workflows, and [agent setup](../references/agent-setup.md) for installing the skill in each agent. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for making changes.

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/YourAKShaw/handoff/issues) before opening a report. Use the bug, improvement, or documentation form when one fits. For a usage question, open a blank issue with a clear question, what you tried, the agent and version you use, and a sanitized copy of the relevant `HANDOFF.md` if it helps.

Share only sanitized examples. Do not post credentials, one-time codes, private source code, or personal data in public issues. Problems with an agent host or model may need to be reported to that provider; include enough context to distinguish them from this skill's guidance.
